name: FNCE 4209
title: Applications in Financial Management
description: An intermediate level course using cases i.e., problems faced by actual firms, to teach students how to apply financial management concepts and techniques to real-world situations.
requirement_description: FNCE 3101 (BUSN majors) or MATH 3650 (Mathematics Actuarial Science Finance majors); open only to Business and Mathematics Actuarial Science Finance majors of junior or higher status. Recommended preparation: OPIM 3103.
